positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: We’re rebuilding the agricultural supply chain with efficiency and transparency to empower food providers and buyers. Our team is responsible for building a robust server-side business logic for product features, and ensuring high performance and responsiveness using Go, Postgres, and REST / GraphQL.

positions.title: Cyber Network Defense Manager
positions.description: We protect the DoD network at the Cyber Protection Team. The team consists of cyber operation technicians and specialists. I lead and work with the team to build and train on techniques and procedures for network defense, forensic analysis, and protecting hosts of various OSes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Our team is responsible for ingestion, storage, and retrieval of main performance data for application performance monitoring. I have designed REST endpoints and database schema for MySQL. I've worked on a Java EE framework on Glassfish, and maintained build system using Gradle. We have also developed a data ingestion pipeline in a micro-service architecture integrated with Kafka running on Kubernetes.

positions.title: Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Our team built and maintained a batch data pipeline running on the Hadoop ecosystem consisting of MapReduce, HDFS, and Pig. I was a part of a small team that developed a real-time processing pipeline using Apache Storm.
